name: 911 Remove Ticket
description: Removes PART SKETCH pages from nest package PDFs, saving output as '{name} Move Ticket Omit.pdf' in a Move Ticket Omit subfolder. Stamps the first page with the batch + nest (red Century Gothic, under Quality Requirements) and fills the blank Material Type cell from the removed move tickets. Originals are untouched.
